prompts.title: Recent Form Rhythm
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 motion-graphics prompt for a Spanish-language football form segment. Reserve the lower quarter for permanent yellow subtitles; all other graphics sit above it. Palette: GoatLab charcoal #101412 background, warm white #edf0e6 type, lime #c5ed74 for Aston Villa emphasis, slate #8ca6bf for Manchester City emphasis. Editorial variant (priority): kinetic typography and rhythmic emphasis. Start on charcoal with a small Spanish heading 'FORMA RECIENTE'. Team names enter as staggered warm-white letterforms, Aston Villa from left, Manchester City from right, with a lime/slate split rule at mid-height. Build a rhythmic three-beat cadence: 'VICTORIAS', 'EMPATES', 'DERROTAS' snap in as Spanish labels using condensed uppercase; each beat pulses a soft lime or slate underline, not a chart axis. No numbers, axes, sample claims or invented match events. Add a subtle parallax push-in and a quick lateral whip transition to the statistical variant at the halfway point. Exit: labels collapse toward centre and resolve into a single Spanish heading 'ÚLTIMOS PARTIDOS' before cutting clean. Statistical variant: grouped count bars, three categories (Victorias, Empates, Derrotas), two teams, shared zero baseline and common scale in partidos. Left group Aston Villa in lime, right group Manchester City in slate; bars rise from baseline with spring ease. Values appear as {{home.wins}}, {{home.draws}}, {{home.losses}}, {{away.wins}}, {{away.draws}}, {{away.losses}}; Spanish labels and unit 'partidos' sit directly under each group. Identify unequal samples with a clear source/sample annotation above the lower quarter: 'source: Bzzoiro · muestra: {{home.n}} y {{away.n}} partidos'. A small Spanish note reads 'muestras comparadas'. Main comparison: wins/draws/losses count pattern. Emphasis: the largest visible count flares warm white while the rest dim to half opacity. Camera: slow vertical push from lower baseline to centre, then settle. Transition: horizontal wipe following the lime/slate rule. Exit: bars settle, annotation holds for two beats, then cut to black with a small lime tick. Keep hierarchy one focal point.

prompts.title: Goal Volume and Leakage
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 football goals segment. Reserve the lower quarter for permanent yellow subtitles. Palette: GoatLab charcoal #101412, warm white #edf0e6, lime #c5ed74 for Aston Villa, slate #8ca6bf for Manchester City. Editorial variant (priority): illustrative football pitch and ball path. Charcoal pitch with faint warm-white touchlines; a stylised ball path arcs from one half to the other, but no specific match event, scorer or minute is shown. Spanish heading 'GOLES' enters as warm-white outline, then fills lime on the first beat and slate on the second. Abstract goal-mouth shapes open like gates; small Spanish labels 'A FAVOR' and 'EN CONTRA' slide in without values. Defensive blocks pulse when the ball path passes, then settle. Camera: slow top-down push with slight parallax on pitch lines. Transition: ball path becomes a vertical wipe into the statistical variant. Exit: ball rolls off-screen and pitch lines fade to charcoal. Statistical variant: paired horizontal bars for each team, two categories 'Goles a favor' and 'Goles recibidos', shared scale in goles and a common zero baseline. Aston Villa bars in lime, Manchester City bars in slate; values resolve as {{home.gf}}, {{home.ga}}, {{away.gf}}, {{away.ga}}. Use direct Spanish labels at bar ends and a unit chip 'goles'. Keep one focal point: the longer bar in each pair glows warm white, the partner dims. Source/sample annotation sits above the lower quarter: 'source: Bzzoiro · muestra: {{home.n}} y {{away.n}} partidos'. A small Spanish note reads 'últimos partidos, no pronóstico'. Bars grow from zero with staggered ease; a thin guide line marks the common maximum without printing extra figures. Camera: locked front view, then a gentle diagonal drift. Transition: paired bars shear into pitch stripes. Exit: all bars retract to zero and a single lime dot holds before cut.

prompts.title: Defensive Shield
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 defensive segment. Reserve the lower quarter for permanent yellow subtitles. Palette: GoatLab charcoal #101412, warm white #edf0e6, lime #c5ed74 for Aston Villa, slate #8ca6bf for Manchester City. Editorial variant (priority): stylised shield composition with defensive energy. Charcoal field, a large warm-white shield outline centred above the lower quarter; left half lime for Aston Villa, right half slate for Manchester City. Spanish heading 'SOLIDEZ DEFENSIVA' enters in condensed uppercase, then splits apart into two team-name plates. Defensive energy appears through concentric pulse rings and tight geometric blocks that snap into the shield; no saves, no specific shots and no invented match events. Small Spanish labels 'ARCOS EN CERO' appear as abstract notches on the shield edge, not as numbers. Camera: slow push-in with a quarter-turn parallax; shield breathing at low amplitude. Transition: shield halves rotate in opposite directions and become the bars of the statistical variant. Exit: shield closes to a single warm-white line, then fades. Statistical variant: paired count bars for clean sheets, two teams, shared zero baseline and common scale in partidos. Left bar Aston Villa in lime, right bar Manchester City in slate. Values resolve as {{home.clean}} and {{away.clean}}; Spanish labels 'Aston Villa FC' and 'Manchester City FC' sit under each bar with unit 'partidos'. Do not convert counts into rates; show separate sample-size chips as {{home.n}} and {{away.n}} partidos. Source/sample annotation above the lower quarter: 'source: Bzzoiro · muestra: {{home.n}} y {{away.n}} partidos'. Main comparison: clean-sheet count against clean-sheet count. Emphasis: the taller bar lifts warm white and casts a soft lime/slate shadow; the other bar dims. Camera: locked, then a small vertical settle. Transition: a shield-shaped mask wipes across. Exit: bars reduce to two thin ticks and the annotation holds for one beat before cut.

prompts.title: Historical Duel
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 head-to-head segment. Reserve the lower quarter for permanent yellow subtitles. Palette: GoatLab charcoal #101412, warm white #edf0e6, lime #c5ed74 for Aston Villa, slate #8ca6bf for Manchester City. Editorial variant (priority): visual duel. Charcoal stage with two team plates facing each other: Aston Villa lime on the left, Manchester City slate on the right, warm-white divider down centre. Spanish heading 'DUELO HISTÓRICO' snaps in above; below it, small Spanish labels 'ASTON VILLA FC' and 'MANCHESTER CITY FC' lock to each side. Use abstract pressure lines, not match events: lime lines push right, slate lines push left, meeting in a pulsing centre seam. No scores, no minutes and no invented incidents. A small Spanish note 'HISTORIAL, NO PRONÓSTICO' appears in warm white. Camera: lateral track from left plate to centre, then quick counter-track to right plate. Transition: centre seam splits into the stacked bar of the statistical variant. Exit: plates slide apart and charcoal closes. Statistical variant: horizontal stacked count bar showing historical results, same unit partidos and one total sample. Segments use lime for {{h2h.homeWins}} 'Victorias Aston Villa', warm-white/grey for {{h2h.draws}} 'Empates', slate for {{h2h.awayWins}} 'Victorias Manchester City'. The full bar length corresponds to {{h2h.total}} 'Cruces previos'. Spanish labels sit inside or beside segments; unit 'partidos' appears once. Source/sample annotation above the lower quarter: 'source: Bzzoiro · muestra: {{h2h.total}} cruces'. Main comparison: historical win counts with draws between them. Emphasis: the larger win segment glows warm white edge while the rest keeps flat fills; a small Spanish caption reads 'dato histórico'. Camera: slow horizontal pan across the bar, then settle on the seam. Transition: segmented bar breaks into vertical duel lines. Exit: total-sample label holds, bar fades, cut to charcoal. Keep hierarchy one focal point.

prompts.title: Form Versus History
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 synthesis segment. Reserve the lower quarter for permanent yellow subtitles. Palette: GoatLab charcoal #101412, warm white #edf0e6, lime #c5ed74 for Aston Villa, slate #8ca6bf for Manchester City. Editorial variant (priority): team reveals and narrative emphasis. Charcoal background; warm-white headline 'FORMA VS HISTORIA' enters in two beats. Aston Villa lime plate rises from lower-left, Manchester City slate plate from lower-right; both reveal Spanish team names and a small Spanish caption 'MUESTRA RECIENTE'. No axes, no sample numbers in the editorial variant and no invented match events. The plates slide toward centre, stop short, and a warm-white seam pulses between them; then a second Spanish caption 'HISTORIAL' cuts in with a brief slate flash. Camera: slow push-in, then a quick lateral reveal from left to right. Transition: the seam becomes a split-screen wipe into the statistical variant. Exit: plates retract and the headline resolves to a single warm-white line. Statistical variant: two-tier horizontal count-bar comparison, shared count scale in partidos, with separate sample chips because the samples differ. Top tier 'Forma reciente' shows {{home.wins}} and {{away.wins}} with Spanish team labels and sample chips {{home.n}} and {{away.n}} partidos. Bottom tier 'Cruces históricos' shows {{h2h.homeWins}} and {{h2h.awayWins}} with sample chip {{h2h.total}} partidos. Use lime for Aston Villa and slate for Manchester City throughout; common zero baseline and one unit chip 'partidos'. Source/sample annotation above the lower quarter: 'source: Bzzoiro · muestra reciente: {{home.n}} y {{away.n}}; muestra histórica: {{h2h.total}}'. Spanish source labels distinguish 'forma reciente' from 'historial'; no published model estimates are supplied, so none are shown. Main tension: recent wins versus historical wins, with samples kept attached; label 'historial, no pronóstico'. Emphasis: the historical Manchester City bar glows warm white edge, while recent bars stay matte. Camera: locked two-tier view with a slow vertical settle. Transition: bars slide into two stacked cards. Exit: cards close, annotation holds one beat, cut to charcoal.
